  rate(nv_inference_request_duration_us[1m])
)

  0.001
)

    or on(app)
    (0 * sum by(app) (rate(vllm_client_requests_total[1m])))
  )
  /
  sum by(app) (rate(vllm_client_requests_total[1m]))
)
